records.riskStatement: The WP2 token leak scanner does not cover every complete SHA256-equivalent encoding, including uppercase SHA256 hex, raw 32-byte digests, and some base64/base64url variants.
records.interpretation: This is an accepted security-test coverage gap. It does not assert or imply that the current production code leaks an API session token or token digest.
constraints: Do not describe the scanner as having complete encoding coverage.
Do not delete or rewrite prior independent-review findings.
Acceptance applies only to personal single-user deployment.

records.riskStatement: Windows 10/11 x64 real-machine Named Mutex validation was not executed, including real mutex creation, second-process acquisition denial, release waiting, abnormal-exit release behavior, and takeover ordering after true mutex release.
records.interpretation: This is an accepted missing-platform-validation risk. It must not be described as Windows Named Mutex real-machine validation having passed.
constraints: Do not claim Windows Named Mutex real-machine validation passed.
Do not delete or rewrite prior WP3 independent-review findings or Windows validation handoff records.
Acceptance applies only to personal single-user deployment.

records.riskStatement: The Windows Evidence generator does not strictly reject every future incomplete PASS result when reboot-boundary validation or required checks are absent.
records.interpretation: Accepted only for the stated owner-only single-user scope. Missing Windows checks must remain visible and must not be represented as complete PASS.
constraints: Do not hide NOT_EXECUTED Windows evidence.
Do not extend the exception to public, commercial, enterprise, or multi-user use.

records.riskStatement: The WP5 Final Packaging tracked handoff/status fields still express the pre-final-review candidate state even though the independent final decision accepted the package.
records.interpretation: This is a governance-field expression inconsistency only. The authoritative state is WP5_ACCEPTED at the accepted Final Delivery HEAD and accepted final source tree.
constraints: Do not reinterpret WP5 as ACTIVE or PENDING.
Do not extend this acceptance to production code, tests, Git identity, evidence, WP6 state, or later work packages.
Do not use stale candidate fields as authority over the final independent audit decision.
